laws.rule: Climbing onto the Borobudur temple structure needs a ticket from the official operator, InJourney Destination Management: IDR 150,000 (about A$11.74, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), daily 8.30 am to 5 pm, including a guide and the upanat sandals that must be worn on the temple.
laws.heading: InJourney Destination Management (state-owned site operator)

local-law.note: Operator source (evidence operational for this line).

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: The Borobudur structure ticket includes a wristband, Upanat temple sandals and a tour guide; climbing is only on this ticket.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Structure visits run 8:30am to 5pm WIB; arrive 30 to 45 minutes before your start. The ground-only ticket is for domestic tourists.
culture-and-protocol.note: Price not recorded (not shown in the page text read).
